records.reasoning: The company demonstrates commitment to regulatory compliance through sustainability reporting frameworks.

records.text: Jasa Marga's sustainability focus on building sustainable operations and business is realized through competitive capabilities. Amid an increasingly competitive industry, competitiveness is highlighted as an important point that must be maintained. Realizing sustainability is important to increase the value of the Company, which will generate added value to Jasa Marga's competitiveness.
records.reasoning: The company positions sustainability as a strategic priority for enhancing competitiveness and business value.

records.text: The Company also continues to strength its fundamentals through a series of business development efforts, cost optimization, strengthening its funding, increasing capabilities, human capital, as well as developing its technology.
records.reasoning: The company emphasizes investment in human capital development as part of its sustainability strategy.

records.text: All of the Company's efforts in running its business are carried out on the principle of sustainability by taking into account the harmony between economic, social, and environmental aspects.
records.reasoning: The company commits to integrating economic, social, and environmental considerations in business operations.

records.text: The Company treats all employees equally. Jasa Marga provides equal opportunities for all employees to improve their competencies for the purpose of career development and to professionally complete their tasks. The Company does not discriminate against ethnicity, religion, race, group, gender, and offers equal opportunities for development based on the employee's potential, abilities, and skills required for the particular position.
records.reasoning: The company demonstrates commitment to equal opportunity and non-discrimination in employment practices.

records.text: As an enabler of employee learning, the Company also provides learning applications that can be accessed in real time by all employees so that learning can be done anytime and anywhere. The application provides various learning features including videos, handouts, e-books, journals and podcasts.
records.reasoning: The company invests in digital learning platforms to enhance employee development capabilities.

records.text: The Employee Learning & Development Program is managed by Jasa Marga Learning Institute (JLI) and is carried out with an effective learning approach of 70:20:10, where in addition to formal learning such as seminars, workshops, formal education, all employees are also given the opportunity to get active learning through coaching, mentoring, sharing and active as resource persons and lecturers both at the Company's internal and external levels.
records.reasoning: The company implements a structured learning approach with diverse methods to enhance employee competencies.

records.text:
Hello and welcome,

I am pleased to present our We Care Sustainability Report for the Fiscal Year 2024. As our organisation continues to evolve, our focus remains on the Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG) issues that are most relevant to our business.

We Care is in our DNA. We are committed to making a positive impact and supporting our people, customers and the communities where we live and work.

This report is also our annual Communication on Progress as a UN Global Compact signatory, reaffirming our commitment to shaping a sustainable future aligned with the UN Sustainable Development Goals.

As a growing global organisation, it is critical for us to stay true to our core purpose and values and to continue to focus on enabling our people to be the best they can be. We embrace strategic improvements to enhance our people skills and capabilities while fostering innovation and positioning ourselves for future growth.

We are a leading provider of next-generation technology services dedicated to helping our customers drive real impact and meaningful change globally. As AI is set to drive the new digital transformation era, our commitment to innovation excellence is evident in the design of our agentic AI Industry Accelerator, Morpheus. This is powered by our focus on developing AI skills across delivery locations and embedding AI in our daily engineering work.

Our dedication to delivering exceptional service and building strong partnerships enables us to maintain high levels of customer satisfaction. We support our clients in their sustainability journeys by leveraging our industry expertise, our ESG partnerships and our green software capabilities. We also use technology as a force for good in collaboration with our customers.

In FY2024, we made significant progress with our environmental agenda by getting our near and long-term science-based emissions reduction targets, and overall science-based net-zero target, approved by the Science Based Targets initiative (SBTi). Our governance efforts continue to focus on preparing for compliance with the EU Corporate Sustainability Reporting Directive (CSRD). We recently completed our Double Materiality Assessment (DMA), the first step in this process.
records.reasoning: CEO highlights climate targets, governance initiatives, and commitment to ESG goals.

records.text:
We care about making a positive difference for our stakeholders:

## For our people
We are committed to being an inclusive community, and our core purpose is to enable our people to be the best they can be.

## For our clients
We focus on building partnerships with our clients to provide innovative digital solutions to increase the positive impact we have on our clients' businesses and sustainability.

## For our investors
We aim to provide our investors with the information they need to understand our ESG priorities and how these initiatives drive the future resilience of our business, allowing them to make informed decisions.

## In our supply chain
We promote sustainable procurement practices and aim to make purchasing decisions that decrease negative effects on society and the environment.

## In our communities
We aim to support the communities where we live and have strategic partnerships with non-governmental organisations (NGOs).
records.reasoning: Emphasis on people, clients, investors, communities and inclusive approach.

records.text:
Endava organises global innovation events annually to challenge Endavans to think differently by creating new concepts and exciting solutions. These events encourage capability growth and allow the exploration of emerging and exciting technologies in software and hardware.

Innovation Lab is the largest internal event organised by our global innovation community annually. This year, 76 teams competed, and 4,000+ Endavans participated. It is an important avenue for continuing to build our proud innovation culture.

This year's theme was to build innovative prototypes suitable for demonstration to clients. The competition allowed the teams to showcase their innovative thinking and skills. In total, 80% of the finalists applied AI practically, illustrating how widespread AI skills are at Endava.

Ten teams from locations across Europe, North America, Australia and Colombia competed in the Global Innovation Lab Final.
records.reasoning: Showcases innovation events, AI adoption and future opportunities.

records.text:
The winner of our 2023 Innovation Lab final was a team from Romania, with Smart Panc, a mobile application acting as an artificial pancreas system companion application for people with Type 1 diabetes and their caregivers.

We interviewed the winners:
Bogdan Iosif, Creative Lead;
Maria Leonte, Developer;
Irina Puscasu, Machine Learning Engineer; and
Andreea Schiau, Developer.

How did you come up with this idea? What inspired your team to develop this companion app?

Bogdan Iosif: I truly believe every great solution starts from someone's needs. This idea started from a personal experience with close family friends. They have a young daughter suffering from Type 1 diabetes. Witnessing their daily challenges with this disease made me think that combining bright minds with technology to create a solution could make their lives easier.

Can you provide an overview of your application's main features and functionalities?

Andreea Schiau: This app's main feature is its ability to predict glucose surges two hours before they occur. Additionally, the app has two other important features: it empowers collaboration by sending alerts and messages and helps caregivers prevent dangerous situations. Smart Panc is an ecosystem that brings together guardians and caregivers collaborating to support a patient. The app is tailored individually for each patient.

How is your app different or better compared to other solutions?

Bogdan Iosif: What makes this solution unique is the use of AI. Using a machine learning (ML) model, we predict glucose levels over the next 2 hours based on the patient's history. This app is proactive, while most other apps currently on the market are reactive and rely on sensors, which often have a 5-to 10-minute reading delay on glucose levels. The ML model is up to 96% accurate on glucose tracking. Additionally, the app can help manage glucose levels by leveraging the phone's camera to assist in quality food selection options.

Did your team encounter any challenges or obstacles?

Irina Puscasu: The biggest challenge was getting the data. A complex AI model needs a lot of accurate data to predict the highs or lows of glycemic indexes accurately. Fortunately, Bogdan's friends shared the data from the child's glucose sensor.

Did you get support from other Endavans?

Bogdan Iosif: Yes, we had a lot of help, especially from our colleagues in the healthcare industry vertical. They introduced us to their network of experts and helped guide the project.

What is next for this application?

Maria Leonte: We are working on better understanding this patient's living habits and feeding this information to the machine learning model to improve predictability.
records.reasoning: Highlights health impact, AI for good, community benefit.

records.text: Hello and welcome, I am pleased to present our We Care Sustainability Report for the Fiscal Year 2024. As our organisation continues to evolve, our focus remains on the Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG) issues that are most relevant to our business. We Care is in our DNA. We are committed to making a positive impact and supporting our people, customers and the communities where we live and work. This report is also our annual Communication on Progress as a UN Global Compact signatory, reaffirming our commitment to shaping a sustainable future aligned with the UN Sustainable Development Goals. Our governance efforts continue to focus on preparing for compliance with the EU Corporate Sustainability Reporting Directive (CSRD). We recently completed our Double Materiality Assessment (DMA), the first step in this process. In FY2024, we made significant progress with our environmental agenda by getting our near and long-term science-based emissions reduction targets, and overall science-based net-zero target, approved by the Science Based Targets initiative (SBTi).
records.reasoning: The passage explicitly discusses climate-related targets, SBTi approval, and governance actions, indicating a clear climate commitment and governance focus.

records.text: In the past year, we have developed our capabilities through several proof-of-concept projects and hackathons, covering carbon awareness, emissions calculation and product eco-labelling. One project reduced CO2e emissions from AI/ML model training by 37% compared to the original cloud region and time schedule, using carbon-aware pipelines. We collaborated with the Green Software Foundation on Software Carbon Intensity scoring and CarbonHack 2024 plugins, and we prototyped a solution for a retail client to calculate CO2e emissions from end-user devices. Clients are engaging us on commercial Green Software projects to build sustainability into the software development lifecycle.
records.reasoning: The segment reports concrete emission reduction results, GHG metrics, and client engagements in green software, reflecting a positive environmental performance and measurable metrics.

records.text: Climate-related risks and opportunities. Climate-related risk assessment process. Journey to Net Zero. Total GHG emissions. Managing our footprint. We are pleased with the efforts we are making.
records.reasoning: The text explicitly mentions climate risks, a net-zero journey, GHG emissions data, and expresses a commitment to environmental targets, fitting multiple climate-specificity labels.

records.text: Endava's approach to Responsible AI (RAI) has produced a continuously evolving framework that embeds RAI dimensions at every stage of the machine learning development life cycle. To ensure the responsible adoption of AI, we've strengthened our ethical governance frameworks, focusing on transparency, accountability, and fairness.
records.reasoning: The passage details AI governance structures, risk mitigation, and ethical frameworks, aligning with governance and risk categories without expressing a clear positive or negative sentiment.

records.text: Jasa Marga's sustainability focus on building sustainable operations and business is realized through competitive capabilities. Amid an increasingly competitive industry, competitiveness is highlighted as an important point that must be maintained. Realizing sustainability is important to increase the value of the Company, which will generate added value to Jasa Marga's competitiveness.
records.reasoning: The text positively frames sustainability as a key business strategy that enhances competitiveness and company value.

records.text: The global and national economic growth has driven performance recovery in most business sectors, including the Jasa Marga toll road business, but this recovery is still overshadowed by various dynamic challenges in 2022. Nonetheless, the Company still managed to record a strong and increasingly resilient performance growth as a result of implementing strategies that focused on balancing growth and financial sustainability that fortifies the Company's resilience.
records.reasoning: The text positively describes the company's ability to maintain resilience and growth despite challenges, with a focus on financial sustainability.

records.text: Jasa Marga always takes advantage of opportunities from the rapid development of digital technology to continue to innovate in improving services amidst the challenges of the COVID-19 pandemic. In 2021, Jasa Marga succeeded in improving its positive performance with the growth of toll revenues, implementation of asset recycling and the determination of work program priorities in the context of operating expenses efficiency. All of the Company's efforts in running its business are carried out on the principle of sustainability by taking into account the harmony between economic, social, and environmental aspects.
records.reasoning: The text positively describes the company's use of digital technology and commitment to sustainability principles across economic, social, and environmental aspects.

records.text: PT Jasa Marga (Persero) Tbk is the first and largest toll road operator in Indonesia. The Company has operated 1,191 km toll road or 51% of the total length of operated toll roads in Indonesia, covering ± 2,346 km. Considering these conditions, Jasa Marga has become the Indonesian toll road industry leader in terms of the total length of operated toll roads and the volume of traffic transactions passing the toll roads.
records.aspect: market leadership and scale of operations
records.reasoning: This is a factual statement about the company's market position without evaluative language, hence neutral sentiment.

records.text: Jasa Marga continuously developed new toll roads to support the achievement of Indonesian economic growth acceleration and distribution. Jasa Marga contributes to the inter-region connectivity strengthening while developing and doubling the Company's business growth.
records.reasoning: The text positively describes the company's contribution to regional connectivity and economic growth.

records.text: Jasa Marga telah berpengalaman selama lebih dari 40 tahun dalam bidang pembangunan dan pengoperasian jalan tol di berbagai wilayah Indonesia.
records.reasoning: This is a factual statement about the company's experience without evaluative language, hence neutral sentiment.

records.text: Tidak terdapat perbedaan kebijakan persentase kontribusi dalam Program Pensiun yang dilaksanakan dalam lingkup Jasa Marga Group.
records.reasoning: This is a factual statement about pension program policy without evaluative language, hence neutral sentiment.

records.text: Setiap tahunnya, dalam rangka melakukan akselerasi kompetensi Karyawan yang sesuai dengan arahan strategis Perseroan ke depan, Program Pembelajaran & Pengembangan Karyawan senantiasa dilakukan kepada seluruh level jabatan Karyawan di Jasa Marga dengan mempertimbangkan learning academy yang ada di Jasa Marga, diantaranya: a. Project Development Academy b. Operational Services Academy c. Technological Innovation Academy d. Business Support Academy e. Leadership Development Academy
records.reasoning: The text positively describes comprehensive employee development programs across various academies.

records.text: The Employee Learning & Development Program is managed by Jasa Marga Learning Institute (JLI) and is carried out with an effective learning approach of 70:20:10, where in addition to formal learning such as seminars, workshops, formal education, all employees are also given the opportunity to get active learning through coaching, mentoring, sharing and active as resource persons and lecturers both at the Company's internal and external levels.
records.reasoning: The text positively describes a structured and comprehensive learning approach for employees.

records.text: As an enabler of employee learning, the Company also provides learning applications that can be accessed in real time by all employees so that learning can be done anytime and anywhere. The application provides various learning features including videos, handouts, e-books, journals and podcasts. With this learning application, employees can obtain learning topics according to individual competency development needs.
records.reasoning: The text positively describes the company's provision of digital learning tools for employees.

records.text: Berkaitan dengan pengembangan kompetensi, Perseroan memiliki kebijakan perlakuan yang sama terhadap seluruh karyawan. Jasa Marga membuka kesempatan yang sama bagi seluruh karyawan dalam meningkatkan kompetensi, pengembangan karier, dan melaksanakan tugas secara profesional tanpa membedakan suku, agama, ras, golongan, gender, dan kondisi fisik sesuai dengan potensi, kemampuan dan keterampilan yang dipersyaratkan.
records.reasoning: The text positively describes the company's commitment to equal opportunity regardless of background.

records.text: However, the Company has not carried out positive and negative impact mapping and set targets for average training hours per year per employee. Mapping and setting new targets will be carried out in 2024
records.reasoning: This is a factual statement about an area for improvement without evaluative language, hence neutral sentiment.

records.text: Rata-rata Jam Pelatihan setiap Karyawan (jam/orang) Average Training Hours for Each Employee (hour/person)

records.text:
Hello and welcome,

I am pleased to present our We Care Sustainability Report for the Fiscal Year 2024. As our organisation continues to evolve, our focus remains on the Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG) issues that are most relevant to our business.

We Care is in our DNA. We are committed to making a positive impact and supporting our people, customers and the communities where we live and work.

This report is also our annual Communication on Progress as a UN Global Compact signatory, reaffirming our commitment to shaping a sustainable future aligned with the UN Sustainable Development Goals.

As a growing global organisation, it is critical for us to stay true to our core purpose and values and to continue to focus on enabling our people to be the best they can be. We embrace strategic improvements to enhance our people skills and capabilities while fostering innovation and positioning ourselves for future growth.

We are a leading provider of next-generation technology services dedicated to helping our customers drive real impact and meaningful change globally. As AI is set to drive the new digital transformation era, our commitment to innovation excellence is evident in the design of our agentic AI Industry Accelerator, Morpheus. This is powered by our focus on developing AI skills across delivery locations and embedding AI in our daily engineering work.

Our dedication to delivering exceptional service and building strong partnerships enables us to maintain high levels of customer satisfaction. We support our clients in their sustainability journeys by leveraging our industry expertise, our ESG partnerships and our green software capabilities. We also use technology as a force for good in collaboration with our customers.

In FY2024, we made significant progress with our environmental agenda by getting our near and long-term science-based emissions reduction targets, and overall science-based net-zero target, approved by the Science Based Targets initiative (SBTi). Our governance efforts continue to focus on preparing for compliance with the EU Corporate Sustainability Reporting Directive (CSRD). We recently completed our Double Materiality Assessment (DMA), the first step in this process.

We also continue to raise Endavans' awareness of the importance of operating responsibly and driving sustainability through our supply chain.

Our sustainability journey is moving forward. I invite you to discover more about our great work to create a positive impact supporting our people, customers, communities and stakeholders.

"We Care is in our DNA. We are committed to making a positive impact and supporting our people, customers and the communities where we live and work."

John Cotterell
CEO

records.text:
Hello and welcome,

I am pleased to present our We Care Sustainability Report for the Fiscal Year 2024. As our organisation continues to evolve, our focus remains on the Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG) issues that are most relevant to our business.

We Care is in our DNA. We are committed to making a positive impact and supporting our people, customers and the communities where we live and work.

This report is also our annual Communication on Progress as a UN Global Compact signatory, reaffirming our commitment to shaping a sustainable future aligned with the UN Sustainable Development Goals.

As a growing global organisation, it is critical for us to stay true to our core purpose and values and to continue to focus on enabling our people to be the best they can be. We embrace strategic improvements to enhance our people skills and capabilities while fostering innovation and positioning ourselves for future growth.

We are a leading provider of next-generation technology services dedicated to helping our customers drive real impact and meaningful change globally. As AI is set to drive the new digital transformation era, our commitment to innovation excellence is evident in the design of our agentic AI Industry Accelerator, Morpheus. This is powered by our focus on developing AI skills across delivery locations and embedding AI in our daily engineering work.

Our dedication to delivering exceptional service and building strong partnerships enables us to maintain high levels of customer satisfaction. We support our clients in their sustainability journeys by leveraging our industry expertise, our ESG partnerships and our green software capabilities. We also use technology as a force for good in collaboration with our customers.

In FY2024, we made significant progress with our environmental agenda by getting our near and long-term science-based emissions reduction targets, and overall science-based net-zero target, approved by the Science Based Targets initiative (SBTi). Our governance efforts continue to focus on preparing for compliance with the EU Corporate Sustainability Reporting Directive (CSRD). We recently completed our Double Materiality Assessment (DMA), the first step in this process.
records.reasoning: Mentions approval of science‑based targets, governance focus on CSRD compliance, and completion of Double Materiality Assessment, indicating a clear commitment to climate and governance goals.

records.text:
Tech for good

Expanding engagement

Working with Grameen America to advance digital financial inclusion

Grameen America is a non‑profit microfinance organisation focused on the urgent need to address systemic lending gaps experienced by women in the U.S., especially those in under‑represented communities. We are delighted with our ongoing relationship with Grameen America and we are supporting them in their ambitious goal to provide opportunities for economic mobility to more than 750,000 women and their families through their 'Women Are Limitless' five‑year campaign. To date, Grameen America has disbursed over $4 billion in loan capital to over 200,000 financially underserved women across 27 U.S. cities, with an impressive 99% loan repayment rate.

To execute on their key strategic priorities, Grameen America is looking to strengthen the organisation's technology, data capabilities, and infrastructure, and to significantly invest in human capital. Over the past two years, we have worked with the organisation on a mobile membership application, which was rolled out across 27 cities in the U.S. and it is now used by 70,000 members, allowing them to access programme information in real time. Grameen America also engaged Endava to build a data warehouse and streamline the internal reporting process, eliminating human errors and allowing Grameen America's staff to focus on value‑adding tasks.

Pro Bono

Helping long COVID patients get their breath back

To help patients suffering from long COVID, the English National Opera (ENO) devised a groundbreaking programme of singing therapy. The ENO team turned to Endava to scale delivery to assist more patients.

During the coronavirus pandemic, ENO members helped patients diagnosed with long covid recover their respiratory functions by learning to sing. In collaboration with Imperial College Healthcare NHS Trust teams, the ENO delivered the ENO Breathe Programme, an online singing therapy programme that targets breathlessness.

The Endava team worked pro bono to develop a digital process optimisation tool that eliminates manual work for registrants and administrators alike. A digital self‑service portal allows patients to register directly for the programme without contacting the ENO.

Thanks to the collaboration, ENO scaled the programme's reach by up to 60 times to serve a maximum of 3,000 patients concurrently.
records.reasoning: Describes pro‑bono digital inclusion projects that expand economic opportunities and health outcomes, reflecting a positive social impact.

records.text:
In March 2024, we announced our partnership with Climatiq, a carbon intelligence solution provider.

Climatiq provides a carbon calculation engine for scope 1, 2 and 3 emissions, covering business activities, including energy consumption, cloud computing, transportation, travel and procurement. Climatiq partners with innovative organisations to integrate their solutions into their software, workflows and daily operations. These solutions support the development of effective carbon reduction strategies and facilitate net‑zero scenario modelling, carbon hotspot identification and forecasting.

Endava developed proofs of concept using Climatiq's software. We plan to expand our efforts using this solution, to develop additional POCs to help our clients achieve their net zero and carbon reduction objectives using our sustainable solutions.

> "Joining forces with YuzeData and Climatiq adds diversity to our partner ecosystem and keeps us moving forward in our sustainability journey."

Lewis Brown
Head of Alliances and Partnerships
records.reasoning: Highlights a partnership that delivers carbon calculation capabilities, supporting net‑zero objectives and climate‑focused commitments.

records.text: Sustainability Governance is one of Danamon's sustainability strategy pillars.
records.reasoning: Governance statement without evaluative context.

records.text: In 2024, Danamon updated its Sustainability Governance structure to improve the effectiveness of bank-wide sustainable finance implementation.

records.text: Danamon established Sustainability Sub-Committee, as part of the Risk Management Committee (RMC).
records.reasoning: Governance structure creation without evaluative context.

records.text: The supervision of sustainable finance implementation is a joint effort involving the Board of Commissioners and the Board of Directors.

records.text: The Sustainability Sub-Committee is chaired by the Director of Syariah & Sustainability Finance, with the Alternate Chairperson being the Director of Global Alliance Strategy.

records.text: Its members include Risk Management Director, Enterprise Banking & Financial Institution Director, and SME Business Head, and Consumer Lending Business Head.

records.text: The meeting is led by the Chairman of Sub-Committee.

records.text: ESG-related risk management as one of the aspects considered in risk management, including climate change risk, as a form of contribution to sustainable growth.

records.text: As part of the Environmental and Social Risk Management implementation, Danamon develops and regularly reviews framework and guideline related to Environmental and Social Risk Management (ESRM).

records.text: Danamon established Sustainability Sub-Committee, as part of the Risk Management Committee (RMC).

records.text: This adjustment considers climate risk management and oversight direction into Bank's risk management, as the expansion of Bank's highest-level committees' roles and responsibilities, in accordance with regulatory requirement for Banks.

records.text: The supervision of sustainable finance implementation is a joint effort involving the Board of Commissioners and the Board of Directors.

records.reasoning: Implementation team structure

records.text: The Sustainability Sub-Committee is chaired by the Director of Syariah & Sustainability Finance, with the Alternate Chairperson being the Director of Global Alliance Strategy.

records.text: Its members include Risk Management Director, Enterprise Banking & Financial Institution Director, and SME Business Head, and Consumer Lending Business Head.
records.reasoning: Committee membership

records.text: Regular meeting of Sustainability Sub-Committee is held at least 2 (two) times in a year.
records.reasoning: Governance meeting frequency

records.text: Realization of the SFAP is reported to and evaluated by the Sustainability Sub-Committee through internal circulation or meeting at minimum every quarter.
records.reasoning: Governance reporting frequency

records.text: ESG-related risk management as one of the aspects considered in risk management, including climate change risk, as a form of contribution to sustainable growth.
records.reasoning: ESG risk management commitment

records.text: Danamon develops and regularly reviews framework and guideline related to Environmental and Social Risk Management (ESRM).
records.reasoning: ESRM framework development

records.text: In the credit process, Sustainability Credit Guideline is a framework that considers ESG aspects into the Bank's internal risk management, primarily credit risk management to its debtors.
records.reasoning: ESG credit risk framework

records.text: ESG-aspect analysis is also carried out through Environmental and Social Risk Analysis (ESRA) in the credit process.
records.reasoning: ESRA implementation

records.text: ESRA guideline is applied since March 2021 for debtors who fall into the category of sectors that have significant ESG risk, primarily in the Financial Institutions (EBFI) line of business.
records.reasoning: ESRA application timeline

records.text: In 2024, Danamon continued the implementation of ESRA to bolster ESG-related risk management on its credit process.
records.reasoning: ESRA continuation

records.text: At the beginning of 2024, OJK issued 6 Guidebooks related to Climate Risk Management and Scenario Analysis (CRMS) to be used as reference on CRMS Pilot Project.
records.reasoning: Regulatory framework reference

records.text: As one of the Bank required by OJK to join CRMS Pilot Project Phase 2, Danamon had reported the result of climate risk scenario analysis for the Bank's 50% total loan portfolio to OJK in July 2024.
records.reasoning: CRMS reporting completion

records.text: Danamon plays an active role in various national Banking associations and is involved in some of the initiatives organized.
records.reasoning: Industry association participation

records.text: During 2024, Danamon participated in The Asia Transition Finance Study Group (ATF SG).
records.reasoning: Transition finance initiative

records.text: ATF SG is a private group led by financial institutions (FIs), mainly Asian and global Banks, promoting transition finance in Asian countries.
records.reasoning: Initiative description

records.text: The Study Group developed guidelines for financial institutions and suggested support measures to relevant parties, outlining progress in the transition finance landscape, including challenges and applicable potential solution.
records.reasoning: Initiative outcomes

records.text: Until the end of 2024, Danamon had not become a part of the Global Systemically Important Bank (G-SIB).
records.reasoning: G-SIB status

records.text: Investment in sustainability instruments also depends on the availability of instruments, opportunities in the market, and the availability of green projects eligible to be financed.
records.reasoning: Market dependency

records.text: This commitment also involves market needs on sustainability financing, mainly transition financing to a low-carbon economy.

records.text: Danamon appreciates the Government's step in implementing sustainable finance through the implementation of regulations and a number of initiatives, guidance, and capacity building.

records.text: Danamon maintains a good and beneficial relationship with all employees, embodied in the Collective Labor Agreement (CLA).

records.reasoning: CLA update

records.text: The CLA is inclusive, applying to all employees at Danamon.
records.reasoning: CLA inclusivity

records.text: Danamon places employee competency development as an important investment, consistent with the Company's strategic focus on people, digital, and branding aspects.
records.reasoning: Training commitment

records.text: Danamon designs all the training and development programs it runs in accordance with Human Resources Policy.
records.reasoning: Training policy

records.text: The Learning, Engagement, and Corporate University Division is responsible for designing training strategies for employees.
records.reasoning: Training responsibility

records.text: Training is one of obligatory yearly KPI to improve their personal skills and abilities.
records.reasoning: Training KPI

records.text: All training programs are carried out routinely to ensure that employee skills remain relevant to Danamon's needs.
records.reasoning: Training routine

records.text: Evaluation of the effectiveness of training programs is measured by determining Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).
records.reasoning: Training evaluation

records.text: Further description of employee development programs can be found in the section on Training and Competency Development on page 277 of this Report.
records.reasoning: Reference to additional information

records.text: To cultivate future leaders, Danamon organizes the Danamon Bankers Trainee (DBT) program.
records.reasoning: Leadership development

records.text: This initiative aims to recruit top-performing graduates from undergraduate and master's programs, equipping them with the essential skills and competencies to excel as future leaders.
records.reasoning: Leadership development commitment

records.text: In 2024, the DBT program was delivered in four batches, engaging a total of 105 participants.
records.reasoning: Program participation

records.text: Over the course of one year, participants underwent an intensive learning journey designed to enhance their qualifications, covering diverse topics ranging from Banking fundamentals to leadership development.
records.reasoning: Program description

records.text: Danamon's employee performance assessment mechanism consists of a series of processes, from Objective Setting, Mid-year Review, to End-year Review.
records.reasoning: Performance assessment process

records.text: Throughout these stages, the Work Unit Leaders (PUK) routinely conduct coaching, tracking, and development for employees to motivate employees to optimize their potential and achieve the best performance.
records.reasoning: Performance coaching

records.text: In 2024, Danamon continued to implement a High-Performance Culture as part of the Bank's DNA by encouraging innovation, improving service for internal customers, creating an inclusive work environment, and providing appreciation to employees in implementing BISA Values.
records.reasoning: High-performance culture

records.text: One form of commitment to an inclusive work environment is the application of the principle of gender equality in performance assessments.
records.reasoning: Gender equality commitment

records.text: In 2024, 54% of 828 employees who received promotions, or 443 employees, were women.
records.reasoning: Gender promotion data

records.text: This reflects Danamon's commitment to building an inclusive work culture with a focus on gender equality and women's empowerment.
records.reasoning: Gender equality commitment

records.text: Danamon's remuneration strategy is designed to motivate, and retain top talent, irrespective of gender, race, age, disability, or other non-performance-related factors.
records.reasoning: Remuneration commitment

records.text: Remuneration are set following the Operational Terms of Reference guidelines, which define minimum wages based on city where employees work.
records.reasoning: Remuneration policy

records.text: Minimum wages are regularly updated to align with the prevailing labor regulation.
records.reasoning: Wage update

records.text: Danamon ensures that all permanent employees are paid above the Provincial Minimum Wage (UMP) and Provincial Sectoral Minimum Wage (UMSP), in compliance with regulations.
records.reasoning: Wage compliance

records.text: The Bank applies an applicable local minimum wage.
records.reasoning: Wage policy

records.text: Additionally, the Bank recognizes exceptional achievements with bonuses and incentives.
records.reasoning: Performance recognition

records.text: There is no difference in the basic salary and remuneration ratio between female and male employees.
records.reasoning: Gender pay equality

records.text: The ratio of basic salary and remuneration between genders is 1:1, reflecting Danamon's commitment to providing equal rewards based on competence, responsibility, and contribution, regardless of gender.
records.reasoning: Gender pay equality commitment

records.text: This policy aligns with Danamon's values that support equality and inclusiveness in the workplace.
records.reasoning: Equality commitment

records.text: In line with Indonesian law, Danamon provides worker protection programs, provides worker protection programs, including BPJS Kesehatan and BPJS Ketenagakerjaan.
records.reasoning: Worker protection

records.text: The latter includes retirement, occupational accident, and death insurance.
records.reasoning: Insurance coverage

records.text: Danamon provides a preretirement program that includes training and provision, such as financial management, exploring business opportunities after retirement, and maintaining health.
records.reasoning: Preretirement program

records.text: By the end of 2024, 237 employees had participated in this program.
records.reasoning: Program participation

records.text: Danamon always strives to create an inclusive and fair work environment in accordance with the established Sustainability Policy.
records.reasoning: Inclusion commitment

records.text: Danamon believes accommodating diverse backgrounds and individual competencies helps Danamon to get more useful ideas and perspectives to improve business performance.
records.reasoning: Diversity commitment

records.text: Therefore, Danamon provides equal employment opportunities for every employee regardless of gender, ethnicity, or other indicators of diversity.
records.reasoning: Equal opportunity commitment

records.reasoning: Describes ongoing implementation of ESG considerations in credit risk management without specific outcome or commitment.

records.text: In its implementation, ESG-aspect analysis is also carried out through Environmental and Social Risk Analysis (ESRA) in the credit process.
records.reasoning: Describes ongoing implementation of ESRA without specific outcome or commitment.

records.reasoning: Describes ongoing application of ESRA since 2021 without specific outcome or commitment.

records.text: In 2024, Danamon continued the implementation of ESRA to bolster ESG-related risk management on its credit process.
records.reasoning: Describes ongoing continuation of ESRA implementation without specific outcome or commitment.

records.text: At the beginning of 2024, OJK issued 6 Guidebooks related to Climate Risk Management and Scenario Analysis (CRMS) to be used as reference on CRMS Pilot Project.
records.reasoning: Describes regulatory development without specific outcome or commitment.

records.reasoning: Describes future-oriented participation in transition finance initiative.

records.reasoning: Describes initiative without specific outcome or commitment.

records.reasoning: Describes future-oriented development of guidelines and support measures.

records.text: Danamon has started its step in ESG-related risk management as one of the aspects considered in risk management, including climate change risk, as a form of contribution to sustainable growth.
records.reasoning: Describes implementation of ESG risk management without specific outcomes.

records.text: In the credit process, Sustainability Credit Guideline is a framework that considers ESG aspects into the Bank's internal risk management, primarily credit risk management to its debtors.
records.reasoning: Describes framework implementation without specific outcomes.

records.text: In its implementation, ESG-aspect analysis is also carried out through Environmental and Social Risk Analysis (ESRA) in the credit process.
records.reasoning: Describes implementation of ESRA without specific outcomes.

records.text: ESRA guideline is applied since March 2021 for debtors who fall into the category of sectors that have significant ESG risk, primarily in the Financial Institutions (EBFI) line of business.
records.reasoning: Describes when ESRA was implemented without specific outcomes.

records.text: In 2024, Danamon continued the implementation of ESRA to bolster ESG-related risk management on its credit process.
records.reasoning: Describes continuation of ESRA implementation without specific outcomes.

records.text: At the beginning of 2024, OJK issued 6 Guidebooks related to Climate Risk Management and Scenario Analysis (CRMS) to be used as reference on CRMS Pilot Project.
records.reasoning: Describes regulatory development without specific outcomes.

records.text: As one of the Bank required by OJK to join CRMS Pilot Project Phase 2, Danamon had reported the result of climate risk scenario analysis for the Bank's 50% total loan portfolio to OJK in July 2024.
records.reasoning: Describes reporting activity without specific outcomes.

records.text: Danamon plays an active role in various national Banking associations and is involved in some of the initiatives organized.
records.reasoning: Describes participation in associations without specific outcomes.

records.text: During 2024, Danamon participated in The Asia Transition Finance Study Group (ATF SG).
records.reasoning: Describes participation in ATF SG without specific outcomes.

records.text: ATF SG is a private group led by financial institutions (FIs), mainly Asian and global Banks, promoting transition finance in Asian countries.
records.reasoning: Describes ATF SG without specific outcomes.

records.text: The Study Group developed guidelines for financial institutions and suggested support measures to relevant parties, outlining progress in the transition finance landscape, including challenges and applicable potential solution.
records.reasoning: Describes ATF SG activities without specific outcomes.

records.text: Danamon implements an Occupational Safety and Health Management System (OSHMS) in line with PP No. 50 of 2012 to ensure the implementation of best practices related to Occupational Health and Safety (OHS) for all employees.
records.reasoning: Describes implementation of OSHMS without specific outcomes.

records.text: OHS management is a shared responsibility between the Human Capital Shared Services (HCSS) Division, CREM, and Health, Safety and Environment (HSE).
records.reasoning: Describes responsibility structure without specific outcomes.

records.text: In addition, the above work units are also responsible for providing adequate OHS facilities and infrastructure, implementing mitigation of occupational diseases, implementing mitigation of disaster or pandemic risks, increasing employee awareness of work safety, and handling work incidents.
records.reasoning: Describes OSHMS responsibilities without specific outcomes.

records.text: Every employee bears the responsibility to maintain a safe, healthy, and responsible work environment, and is required to report incidents that occur.
records.reasoning: Describes employee responsibilities without specific outcomes.

records.text: To strengthen OHS awareness, Danamon utilizes various communication platforms, including e-mail, WhatsApp, Telegram App, e-learning, and seminars or webinars.
records.reasoning: Describes communication methods without specific outcomes.

records.text: In terms of competency improvement, employees from the HSE and BCM Divisions receive special training with General OHS Expert certification, while all employees receive training and socialization regarding OHS periodically.
records.reasoning: Describes training activities without specific outcomes.

records.text: Danamon also appoints HSE Officers at each level of the organization who are tasked with overseeing the implementation of OHS in their teams.
records.reasoning: Describes appointment of HSE officers without specific outcomes.

records.text: During the reporting period, there were no occupational related incident.
records.reasoning: No incidents occurred, which is a positive outcome.

records.text: Danamon provides health benefits to all employees through the BPJS Kesehatan and Health Insurance programs in accordance with the Human Capital Policy.
records.reasoning: Describes health benefits provision without specific outcomes.

records.text: This benefit facilitates employees in accessing health services at various hospitals, clinics, and other health facilities.
records.reasoning: Describes access to health services without specific outcomes.

records.text: Danamon employees who are over 40 years old are given free medical check-up facilities once a year.
records.reasoning: Describes medical check-up provision without specific outcomes.

records.text: Danamon, in line with MUFG policy, is committed to respecting human rights in accordance with the Universal Declaration of Human Rights and related international covenants.
records.reasoning: Describes commitment to human rights without specific outcomes.

records.text: The implementation of respect for human rights is stipulated in the Code of Conduct which includes; freedom of association and participation in organizations; prohibition of all forms of harassment, slander, assault, persecution, and threats; and in the implementation of human resources policies including; legal protection of employees and wages.
records.reasoning: Describes human rights implementation without specific outcomes.

records.text: There were no cases of human rights violations that occurred within Bank Danamon throughout the reporting period.
records.reasoning: No human rights violations occurred, which is a positive outcome.

records.text: Danamon launched the Danamon Berdaya Mengusung Kesetaraan (DAYATARA) program in early October 2024.
records.reasoning: Describes launch of DAYATARA program without specific outcomes.

records.text: This program is designed to build a diverse, equitable and inclusive work environment at Danamon.
records.reasoning: Describes purpose of DAYATARA without specific outcomes.

records.text: To achieve this, first initiative implemented is providing internship opportunities for people with disabilities, both at the head office and at Danamon branch offices in various cities in Indonesia.
records.reasoning: Describes internship initiative without specific outcomes.

records.text: By providing opportunities for individuals with disabilities, Danamon opens the door to new collaborations that may have not been encountered before.
records.reasoning: Describes potential benefits without specific outcomes.

records.text: These partnerships bring fresh perspectives and innovative ideas that enrich our work environment and enhance our collective growth.
records.reasoning: Describes potential benefits without specific outcomes.

records.text: The name DAYATARA is the result of an internal competition involving employees, where all employees were given the opportunity to propose creative ideas related to the name of this inclusion and diversity program.
records.reasoning: Describes naming process without specific outcomes.

records.text: To support the success of the program, Danamon has partnered with Setara Berdaya Inklusif (Alun Jiva) in implementing workshops and onboarding programs, with the aim of preparing Danamon employees as mentors and buddies who can optimally assist interns.
records.reasoning: Describes partnership without specific outcomes.

records.text: The DAYATARA Internship program will take six months; it has started since October 1, 2024, and will end on March 31, 2025.
records.reasoning: Describes timeline without specific outcomes.

records.text: This initiative is expected to not only strengthen inclusion in Danamon's work environment but also inspire other companies to create a more inclusive work environment in the future.
records.reasoning: Describes expectations without specific outcomes.

records.text: Danamon, in collaboration with MUFG Innovation Partners Co. Ltd (MUIP), has formed a strategic partnership to strengthen financial inclusion in Indonesia through an investment in Qoala, a startup Company in the insurance technology sector.
records.reasoning: ESG product implementation without evaluative context.

records.text: This investment is made through the MUFG Innovation Garuda No. 1 Limited Investment Partnership, or MUIP Garuda Fund, a joint initiative between MUFG, MUIP, and Danamon, with a total allocation of US$100 million to invest in Indonesian startups during the period 2023–2028.
records.reasoning: ESG product financial metric without evaluative context.

records.text: The investment provided by Danamon and MUIP to Qoala is driven by a shared vision and mission to promote financial inclusion for the people of Indonesia.
records.reasoning: ESG product motivation statement without evaluative context.

records.text: Qoala, as an insurtech Company, offers easily accessible insurance solutions through an integrated digital platform, machine learning technology, and innovative digital workflows.
records.reasoning: ESG product description without evaluative context.

records.text: This investment aligns with Danamon's commitment to growing alongside its customers and partners and supporting them at every stage of life with relevant financial solutions.
records.reasoning: ESG product alignment statement without evaluative context.

records.text: Sharia Social Financing
records.reasoning: ESG product statement without evaluative context.

records.text: Through its Sharia Business Unit, Danamon has signed a Sustainable Sharia Social Financing (PSSB) agreement with PT Permodalan Nasional Madani (PNM) and MUFG Bank.
records.reasoning: ESG product implementation without evaluative context.

records.text: This is the first PSSB with woman empowerment in Indonesia and has a value of IDR500 billion, based on a Social Loan Financing Framework verified by an internationally-acclaimed Second Party Opinion.
records.reasoning: ESG product financial metric without evaluative context.

records.text: The funds will be used to finance working capital for ultra-micro funding through the PNM program, Fostering a Prosperous Family Economy (Mekaar), in accordance with the principles and requirements set out in the Social Financing Framework.
records.reasoning: ESG product implementation statement without evaluative context.

records.text: Mekaar is a capital loan service for empowering underprivileged women who are ultra-micro entrepreneurs.
records.reasoning: ESG product description without evaluative context.

records.text: This financing initiative reflects Danamon's commitment to supporting the Sustainable Development Goals, especially to eradicate poverty, create decent work and economic growth, and reduce inequality.
records.reasoning: ESG product alignment statement without evaluative context.

records.text: Laku Pandai [SASB FN-CB-240a.3]
records.reasoning: ESG product statement without evaluative context.

records.text: Laku Pandai is a financial inclusion program initiated by OJK that is aimed at offering IT-backed financial services through collaboration with Bank agents.
records.reasoning: ESG product description without evaluative context.

records.text: Until the end of 2024, Laku Pandai program has involved 2,207 customers with total funds collected amounting to IDR99.7 million.
records.reasoning: ESG product financial metric without evaluative context.

records.text: This program involves 35 agents, consisting of 33 individual agents and two legal entity agents.
records.reasoning: ESG product participation metric without evaluative context.

records.text: Laku Pandai service uses a Unstructured Supplementary Service Data (USSD) connection facility which due to a strategic decision from the Danamon was discontinued because it was deemed technologically inadequate.
records.reasoning: ESG product discontinuation without evaluative context.

records.text: Therefore, Danamon carried out an evaluation for one year to find a solution for the benefit of customers.
records.reasoning: ESG product evaluation without evaluative context.

records.text: By terminating the USSD connection, Laku Pandai will automatically stop.
records.reasoning: ESG product termination without evaluative context.

records.text: Danamon remains committed to provide Laku Pandai alternative choices for Customers and Agents with D-Wallet which is a Danamon e-wallet application.
records.reasoning: ESG product commitment without evaluative context.

records.text: D-Wallet provides ease for customers to carry out various transactions ranging from payments, purchases and QRIS.
records.reasoning: ESG product description without evaluative context.

records.text: ESG-Based Investment Products
records.reasoning: ESG product statement without evaluative context.

records.text: Danamon offers ESG-based investment products that can diversify their portfolio, which include:
records.reasoning: ESG product statement without evaluative context.

records.text: BNP Paribas SRI - Kehati;
records.reasoning: ESG product statement without evaluative context.

records.text: Eastspring IDX ESG Leaders Plus;
records.reasoning: ESG product statement without evaluative context.

records.text: BRI MSCI Indonesia ESG Screened Class A.
records.reasoning: ESG product statement without evaluative context.

records.text: Bank's customers can access these investment products through the D-Bank PRO application.
records.reasoning: ESG product access statement without evaluative context.

records.text: Danamon also offers Wealth Advisory services that let customers get more in-depth investment guidance.
records.reasoning: ESG product service statement without evaluative context.

records.reasoning: Document header without evaluative context.

records.text: This investment is made through the MUFG Innovation Garuda No. 1 Limited Investment Partnership, or MUIP Garuda Fund.
records.reasoning: Investasi melalui dana kemitraan.

records.text: The investment provided by Danamon and MUIP to Qoala is driven by a shared vision and mission to promote financial inclusion for the people of Indonesia.
records.reasoning: Visi dan misi investasi.

records.text: Qoala, as an insurtech Company, offers easily accessible insurance solutions through an integrated digital platform.
records.reasoning: Solusi asuransi yang mudah diakses.

records.text: This investment aligns with Danamon's commitment to growing alongside its customers and partners and supporting them at every stage of life with relevant financial solutions.
records.reasoning: Keselarasan investasi dengan komitmen.

records.text: Through its Sharia Business Unit, Danamon has signed a Sustainable Sharia Social Financing (PSSB) agreement with PT Permodalan Nasional Madani (PNM) and MUFG Bank.
records.reasoning: Perjanjian pembiayaan sosial syariah.

records.text: This is the first PSSB with woman empowerment in Indonesia and has a value of IDR500 billion.
records.reasoning: Nilai dan dampak PSSB.

records.text: The funds will be used to finance working capital for ultra-micro funding through the PNM program, Fostering a Prosperous Family Economy (Mekaar).
records.reasoning: Penggunaan dana PSSB.

records.text: Mekaar is a capital loan service for empowering underprivileged women who are ultra-micro entrepreneurs.
records.reasoning: Layanan pemberdayaan perempuan.

records.text: This financing initiative reflects Danamon's commitment to supporting the Sustainable Development Goals, especially to eradicate poverty, create decent work and economic growth, and reduce inequality.
records.reasoning: Komitmen terhadap SDGs.

records.text: Laku Pandai is a financial inclusion program initiated by OJK that is aimed at offering IT-backed financial services through collaboration with Bank agents.
records.reasoning: Program inklusi keuangan.

records.text: Until the end of 2024, Laku Pandai program has involved 2,207 customers with total funds collected amounting to IDR99.7 million.
records.reasoning: Partisipasi dalam program Laku Pandai.

records.text: This program involves 35 agents, consisting of 33 individual agents and two legal entity agents.
records.reasoning: Agen yang terlibat dalam program.

records.text: Laku Pandai service uses a Unstructured Supplementary Service Data (USSD) connection facility which due to a strategic decision from the Danamon was discontinued because it was deemed technologically inadequate.
records.reasoning: Penghentian layanan USSD.

records.text: Therefore, Danamon carried out an evaluation for one year to find a solution for the benefit of customers.
records.reasoning: Evaluasi solusi untuk pelanggan.

records.text: By terminating the USSD connection, Laku Pandai will automatically stop.
records.reasoning: Penghentian program Laku Pandai.

records.text: Danamon remains committed to provide Laku Pandai alternative choices for Customers and Agents with D-Wallet which is a Danamon e-wallet application.
records.reasoning: Komitmen menyediakan alternatif D-Wallet.

records.text: D-Wallet provides ease for customers to carry out various transactions ranging from payments, purchases and QRIS.
records.reasoning: Kemudahan transaksi dengan D-Wallet.

records.text: Danamon offers ESG-based investment products that can diversify their portfolio, which include:
records.reasoning: Penawaran produk investasi ESG.

records.text: BNP Paribas SRI - Kehati;
records.reasoning: Produk investasi ESG.

records.text: Eastspring IDX ESG Leaders Plus;
records.reasoning: Produk investasi ESG.

records.text: BRI MSCI Indonesia ESG Screened Class A.
records.aspect: BRI MSCI Indonesia ESG Screened Class A
records.reasoning: Produk investasi ESG.

records.text: Bank's customers can access these investment products through the D-Bank PRO application.
records.aspect: akses produk investasi melalui D-Bank PRO
records.reasoning: Akses produk investasi melalui aplikasi.

records.text: Danamon also offers Wealth Advisory services that let customers get more in-depth investment guidance.
records.reasoning: Layanan konsultasi investasi.

records.text: Danamon has started its step in ESG-related risk management as one of the aspects considered in risk management, including climate change risk, as a form of contribution to sustainable growth.
records.reasoning: Statement about commitment to ESG-related risk management including climate change risk, indicating future intention without measurable outcome.

records.text: As part of the Environmental and Social Risk Management implementation, Danamon develops and regularly reviews framework and guideline related to Environmental and Social Risk Management (ESRM).
records.reasoning: Describes ongoing development and review of ESRM framework, indicating active implementation of ESG risk management practices.

records.text: In the credit process, Sustainability Credit Guideline is a framework that considers ESG aspects into the Bank's internal risk management, primarily credit risk management to its debtors.
records.reasoning: Explains implementation of ESG considerations in credit risk management through Sustainability Credit Guideline framework.

records.text: In its implementation, ESG-aspect analysis is also carried out through Environmental and Social Risk Analysis (ESRA) in the credit process.
records.reasoning: Describes active implementation of ESRA for ESG analysis in credit processes.

records.text: ESRA guideline is applied since March 2021 for debtors who fall into the category of sectors that have significant ESG risk, primarily in the Financial Institutions (EBFI) line of business.
records.reasoning: Provides specific timeline for ESRA implementation, indicating established ESG risk management practice.

records.text: In 2024, Danamon continued the implementation of ESRA to bolster ESG-related risk management on its credit process.
records.reasoning: Indicates ongoing commitment to ESG risk management through continued ESRA implementation.

records.text: At the beginning of 2024, OJK issued 6 Guidebooks related to Climate Risk Management and Scenario Analysis (CRMS) to be used as reference on CRMS Pilot Project.
records.reasoning: Describes regulatory development in climate risk management without indicating Danamon's specific action.

records.text: As one of the Bank required by OJK to join CRMS Pilot Project Phase 2, Danamon had reported the result of climate risk scenario analysis for the Bank's 50% total loan portfolio to OJK in July 2024.
records.reasoning: Reports completed climate risk scenario analysis for 50% of loan portfolio, indicating measurable outcome of ESG risk management.

records.text: Danamon plays an active role in various national Banking associations and is involved in some of the initiatives organized.
records.reasoning: Describes active participation in banking associations without specific ESG outcomes.

records.text: During 2024, Danamon participated in The Asia Transition Finance Study Group (ATF SG).
records.reasoning: Indicates participation in transition finance study group, showing engagement in sustainable finance initiatives.

records.text: The Study Group developed guidelines for financial institutions and suggested support measures to relevant parties, outlining progress in the transition finance landscape, including challenges and applicable potential solution.
records.reasoning: Describes development of transition finance guidelines, indicating measurable outcome of study group participation.

records.text: Digital products and services have helped reduce our carbon footprint by minimizing the use of paper and the need for customers to visit branches.
records.reasoning: Claims positive environmental impact through reduced carbon footprint from digital services.

records.text: In 2024, Danamon launched several digital products and services, including: Virtual Debit Card Creation, Money Collection Feature with BI FAST API, Digital Teller, QRIS with Credit Cards as a Source of Funds, D-Wallet Replatform, Cash Withdrawal at Other Bank ATMs, BPJS Employment Payment, Mutual Fund Online, Travel Insurance, Account Opening via Mobile Banking, Physical Debit Card Request, Liveness-Face Recognition, Danamon More Pro Account Creation for New-to-Bank at D-Bank PRO.
records.reasoning: Lists digital product launches without explicit ESG context or environmental claims.

records.text: In order to improve customer service, Danamon discontinued D-Bank Registration and recommended customers to switch to D-Bank PRO.
records.reasoning: Describes product discontinuation for customer service improvement without ESG context.

records.text: Currently, the Bank continues to develop the D-Bank PRO service which is a digital service of Danamon and offers convenience and integration of various customer needs.
records.reasoning: Describes ongoing development of digital service without explicit ESG context.

records.text: This is in line with the Bank's strategy to merge the Bank's services into one application, the D-Bank PRO application.
records.reasoning: Describes strategic consolidation of services without ESG context.

records.text: This merger aims to increase the effectiveness and convenience of customers in conducting transactions after opening an account, as well as strengthening the Bank's brand awareness.
records.reasoning: Describes merger objectives focused on customer convenience and brand awareness without ESG context.

records.text: Danamon has been consistent in improving its digital Banking application.
records.reasoning: Describes ongoing improvement of digital banking without explicit ESG context.

records.text: The D-Bank PRO application now comes with features and services for credit cards and personal loans, foreign exchange transactions, e-money top-ups, personal data updates, and biller option expansion.
records.reasoning: Lists application features without explicit ESG context.

records.text: To improve transaction security, Danamon has adopted a Fraud Monitoring System that can detect potential fraud.
records.reasoning: Describes security measure implementation without ESG context.

records.text: In 2024, Danamon continuously made improvements to the D-Bank PRO application, including: Online mutual funds transactions, Simplified customer onboarding process, BPJS-TK subscription fee payment, Money transfer with credit card as source of fund, Virtual debit card creation.
records.reasoning: Lists specific improvements to digital application without explicit ESG context.

records.text: In 2024, Danamon gathered from internal suggestions and customer feedback to enhance our digital infrastructures.
records.reasoning: Describes enhancement of digital infrastructure based on feedback without ESG context.

records.text: The changes we made throughout the year are as follow: Infrastructure and Data Enhancements, Cyber Security & Regulatory Compliance.
records.reasoning: Describes infrastructure changes without explicit ESG context.

records.text: Enhancing infrastructure and optimizing data are crucial steps to ensuring operational efficiency and system resilience.
records.reasoning: Describes infrastructure optimization for operational efficiency without ESG context.

records.text: Some of the initiatives undertaken by Danamon include: The relocation of data center to the premises of a provider that has adequate certifications, Machine learning adoption in IT service monitoring.
records.reasoning: Lists specific infrastructure initiatives without explicit ESG context.

records.text: As cyber threats grow more complex and regulations in the financial sector become more stringent, strengthening cybersecurity and ensuring regulatory compliance have become top priorities.
records.reasoning: Describes cybersecurity priorities without explicit ESG context.

records.text: Some of the strategic measures implemented by Danamon include: Vulnerabilities early detection (Advance Threat Protection), User behaviour analysis, End-point protection tool, ISO 27001 certification in the Application Development and Operations of D-Bank Pro and Danamon Cash Connect (DCC).
records.reasoning: Lists cybersecurity measures without explicit ESG context.

records.text: Danamon is enhancing its project management processes through regular reviews and updates to its prioritization framework.
records.reasoning: Describes project management enhancement without explicit ESG context.

records.text: Project Development Life Cycle (PDLC) SOP has also been established to better govern project management.
records.reasoning: Describes establishment of project management SOP without ESG context.

records.text: This ensures that projects are completed efficiently and on schedule.
records.reasoning: Describes outcome of project management improvements without ESG context.

records.text: Furthermore, the Bank encourages digital product development.
records.reasoning: Describes encouragement of digital product development without explicit ESG context.

records.text: This agile culture is supported using automated tools, which streamline the integration and deployment phases, facilitating a more dynamic and responsive work environment.
records.reasoning: Describes support for agile culture without explicit ESG context.

records.text: Customer data leakages are negative impacts that may occur alongside the increasing number of digitalization initiatives due to technological advancements.
records.reasoning: Identifies potential negative impact of digitalization without specific ESG context.

records.text: Danamon is committed to protecting the data of its customers, business partners, and employees by implementing strict data security standards and utilizing the latest technology.
records.reasoning: Describes commitment to data protection without explicit ESG context.

records.text: Danamon utilizes technology by implementing system security standards to create a more effective and efficient business.
records.reasoning: Describes technology utilization for business efficiency without ESG context.

records.text: People can now utilize safe, practical and quick financial services wherever they are through the D-Bank PRO digital application.
records.reasoning: Describes positive outcome of digital application without explicit ESG context.

records.text: Despite this, the use of technology in Banking operations is not without the risk of customer personal data breaches.
records.reasoning: Identifies potential negative impact of technology use without specific ESG context.

records.text: Securing Personal Data is one of Danamon's main focuses when running a business.
records.reasoning: Describes focus on personal data security without explicit ESG context.

records.text: Danamon will continue to strive better implementation of Personal Data protection measures from time to time by also taking into account the standard practices prevailing in similar industries.
records.reasoning: Describes commitment to continuous improvement of data protection without explicit ESG context.

records.text: Danamon also regularly educates all its employees to ensure a comprehensive understanding of the importance of information security.
records.reasoning: Describes employee education on information security without explicit ESG context.

records.text: This education is conducted through various methods, including e-mail broadcasts, social media broadcasts, simulations, training sessions, and e-learning.
records.reasoning: Lists specific education methods without explicit ESG context.

records.reasoning: Describes compliance with regulations without explicit ESG context.

records.text: Tahun 2024 menandai tonggak sejarah penting bagi Alfamart yang memasuki usia 25 tahun. Momen ini tidak hanya sekadar perayaan, tetapi juga refleksi dari perjalanan panjang yang telah dilalui dalam mengembangkan bisnis ritel yang berfokus pada pelayanan dan efisiensi. "Alfamart Melayani" menjadi penekanan atas tekad Alfamart untuk terus memberikan layanan terbaik kepada pelanggan dan berusaha melampaui harapan pelanggan yang terus berkembang, dengan tetap memastikan efisiensi operasional di semua lini melalui sinergi dari seluruh insan Alfamart, sehingga dapat memberikan nilai lebih kepada pelanggan dan pemangku kepentingan serta tumbuh berkelanjutan. Dalam upaya untuk meningkatkan pelayanan kepada pelanggan dan masyarakat secara lebih luas, Alfamart terus berupaya mengintegrasikan praktik bisnis yang ramah lingkungan dalam operasionalnya. Dengan demikian, "Alfamart Melayani" bukan hanya tentang memenuhi kebutuhan pelanggan, tetapi juga tentang berkontribusi pada keberlanjutan sosial dan lingkungan di sekitar.

records.reasoning: The theme emphasizes Alfamart's determination to integrate environmentally friendly practices and contribute to social and environmental sustainability, indicating a strategic commitment with specific environmental claims.

records.text: Perjalanan lebih dari 2 (dua) dekade Alfamart di industri ritel Tanah Air mendorong seluruh insan Alfamart untuk terus berkarya dan mengukir makna berkelanjutan bagi Perseroan dan para pemangku kepentingan lainnya sejalan dengan nilai-nilai budaya serta visi dan misi perusahaan. "Menginspirasi dengan Karya dan Budaya", menunjukkan bahwa sebagai Perusahaan, Alfamart memiliki komitmen untuk terus bergerak ke depan dan menjadi lebih maju dari masa ke masa. records.reasoning: The theme journey highlights Alfamart's commitment to continuous improvement and cultural values, focusing on social aspects through employee and stakeholder engagement as part of long-term strategy.

records.text: Perseroan dan Entitas Anak mengimplementasikan program loyalitas yang dirancang untuk memberikan nilai lebih kepada pelanggan yang terdaftar sebagai member. Inisiatif ini terbukti menjadi strategi yang efektif dalam mempertahankan pelanggan setia sekaligus menarik perhatian konsumen baru. Dengan bergabung sebagai member, pelanggan dapat menikmati berbagai keuntungan, seperti akumulasi bonus poin untuk setiap transaksi, diskon khusus pada produk tertentu, serta kejutan menyenangkan pada hari ulang tahun mereka. Selain itu, program ini juga menawarkan undian berhadiah dan promo eksklusif bagi star member, yang semakin menambah daya tarik dan keuntungan bagi anggota.
records.reasoning: The loyalty program is described as an effective strategy for retaining and attracting customers, enhancing customer satisfaction and loyalty, which contributes to social sustainability through stakeholder engagement.

records.text: Pemasaran digital kini telah menjadi elemen kunci dalam strategi pemasaran yang menyeluruh bagi Perseroan dan Entitas Anak. Dengan memanfaatkan saluran digital, khususnya melalui aplikasi mobile, perusahaan mampu memperluas jangkauan serta meningkatkan interaksi dengan target audiens secara efektif. Aplikasi mobile memungkinkan pelanggan untuk dengan mudah mengakses berbagai penawaran dan promosi yang tersedia, memberikan kenyamanan dan kemudahan yang sangat dihargai oleh konsumen modern. records.text: PTBA berkomitmen mendukung target Pemerintah mencapai nol emisi. PTBA juga berkomitmen untuk menjalankan bisnis berkelanjutan dengan menerapkan keselarasan antara aspek Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG).
records.reasoning: Statement shows commitment to sustainability and ESG alignment without specific actions or outcomes mentioned.

records.text: Untuk mendukung itu, Perseroan senantiasa melakukan berbagai optimasi menuju pertambangan yang lebih ramah lingkungan. Langkah nyata yang diambil antara lain menerapkan eco, mechanized mining yaitu mengganti peralatan pertambangan yang menggunakan bahan bakar fosil menjadi elektrik, e-mining reporting system yaitu, system pelaporan produksi secara real time dan daring dan berbagai program manajemen karbon di area operasional penambangan.
records.reasoning: Describes specific actions taken to make mining more environmentally friendly, including concrete steps like replacing equipment and implementing reporting systems.

records.text: Perseroan juga menciptakan sinergi dan kerja sama dengan berbagai mitra strategis dalam mewujudkan energi bersih seperti pengembangan PLTS, PLTB, tanaman Kaliandra untuk mengurangi emisi karbon dan menjadi simpanan biomassa untuk diolah menjadi wood pellet sebagai bahan campuran co-firing di PLTU serta Carbon Capture, Utilization (CCU) atau penangkapan karbon dioksida dan dikonversi menjadi methanol.
